API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIEmergency Access ManagementDeactivates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
Deactivates the emergency access user for the specified customer.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/emergencyAccess/user/:userId/deactivate

Deactivates the emergency access user for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

userId
string
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the emergency access user.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
